chunks.arabic_text: وَ رَوَى ٱلْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ:

translations.en: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Hishām ibn Sālim, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

chunks.arabic_text: فِي رَجُلٍ تَزَوَّجَ ذِمِّيَّةً عَلَى مُسْلِمَةٍ قَالَ «يُفَرَّقُ بَيْنَهُمَا وَ يُضْرَبُ ثُمُنَ ٱلْحَدِّ ٱثْنَيْ عَشَرَ سَوْطًا وَ نِصْفًا فَإِنْ رَضِيَتِ ٱلْمُسْلِمَةُ ضُرِبَ ثُمُنَ ٱلْحَدِّ وَ لَمْ يُفَرَّقْ بَيْنَهُمَا»

translations.en: Concerning a man who married a dhimmī woman while already married to a Muslim woman, he عليه السلام said: "They are to be separated, and he is to be struck one-eighth of the hadd, twelve and a half lashes. Then if the Muslim woman consents, he is to be struck one-eighth of the hadd, and they are not to be separated."

chunks.arabic_text: قُلْتُ كَيْفَ يُضْرَبُ ٱلنِّصْفَ قَالَ «يُؤْخَذُ ٱلسَّوْطُ بِٱلنِّصْفِ فَيُضْرَبُ بِهِ».

translations.en: I said: "How is the half administered?" He عليه السلام said: "The whip is taken by the middle, then he is struck with it."

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a man who marries a dhimmī woman while already having a Muslim wife. It states that separation applies unless the Muslim wife consents, while in both cases a fixed disciplinary punishment of one-eighth of the hadd is administered. The narration also clarifies the practical method for administering half a lash.
en.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man marries a dhimmī woman while already married to a Muslim woman?

key_terms.ذِمِّيَّةً: a non-Muslim woman under Muslim protection
key_terms.ثُمُنَ ٱلْحَدِّ: one-eighth of the prescribed hadd punishment
key_terms.سَوْطًا: a lash or strike with a whip
